detail.longDescription: 🤖 Rackspace Spot breach: leaked credentials let attackers impersonate users on the managed K8s platform (Nov 17, 12:20–22:00 UTC). They deployed pods, listed nodes/volumes and read cluster secrets (API tokens, keys). Sessions revoked, keys rotated. 🔗 https://www. scmagazine.com/news/rackspace- discloses-security-breach-of-spot-cloud-platform # DataBreach # Kubernetes # CloudSecurity # InfoSec
